name: g42_roost_pivot
purpose: Roost and a pivot in the same turn: Dragonite (Jolly, faster than Quaquaval) is chipped by the Sandstorm and Roosts on turn 2; Quaquaval then U-turns on it, so the pivot boundary (a request inside the turn, before the residual) shows the Roost volatile on Dragonite and Quaquaval has left its position. Turn 3 Dragonite Dragon Claws, and the Roost bit is gone.
